snippet.title: Free D.C.! gameplay (PC Game, 1991)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Free D.C.!, Dos PC game produced by Cineplay Interactive in 1991 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/free-dc/325/
Free D.C. is an adventure game, in which conversations with other characters provide most of the clues. In this game you have to interact with a robot, and you must meet different actions.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
